documentSettings.notes: Import requires backward-compatible documentSettings/documentPolicies schema implementation. Existing catalog sections preserved verbatim.

intents.description: Visitor plans to establish a new ANCFZ company and wants setup assistance.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Initial discovery: acknowledge business idea and ask what the visitor will sell or do only if not said; then optionally clarify visas. Do not ask for a contact immediately.

intents.description: Visitor requests an FZE formation for one shareholder.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Use when single owner is explicit; explain FZE from approved material; ask about activity or visa needs once. Never promise legal eligibility.

intents.description: Visitor requests an FZC for two or more shareholders.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Use when multiple shareholders are explicit; clarify partner count only if necessary; do not presume a company form from an ambiguous plural.

intents.description: Overseas company asks to establish a branch at ANCFZ.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Explore parent company jurisdiction and planned UAE activity. Document request optional and consent-based. Branch approval needs verification.

intents.description: Existing UAE company asks to open an ANCFZ branch.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Existing UAE entity branch inquiry; distinguish branch setup from new company; ask about current entity and activity only when needed.

intents.description: Visitor asks about moving an existing business to the free zone.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Clarify whether they want a branch, a new free-zone entity, or practical relocation of operations; do not assert license transfer is automatic.

intents.description: Visitor asks whether their proposed activity can be licensed.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Answer from verified activity catalog. Ask for plain-language activity description only if ambiguous; do not invent a code or declare approval.

intents.description: Software, programming, cybersecurity or cloud business setup enquiry.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Identify software development, SaaS, IT consulting, cloud or security as sub-activities from what user says. Check verified exact codes.

intents.description: Management, professional or specialist consultancy setup enquiry.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Distinguish management consulting from any regulated professional service; verify approvals before promising scope.

intents.description: Marketing, advertising, content or media licence enquiry.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Explore marketing, media, content, ads or creative business; clarify only when activities differ for licensing.

intents.description: General trading, import-export, wholesale or ecommerce licence enquiry.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Find out what goods are traded when required for license fit; ecommerce vs trading is not automatically the same activity.

intents.description: Freight, cargo, delivery, storage or logistics business licence enquiry.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Distinguish warehousing, courier, transportation and freight; ask follow-up only to avoid misleading eligibility.

intents.description: Bookkeeping, accounting, audit or tax consultancy licence enquiry.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Distinguish bookkeeping and regulated audit/tax representations. No blanket approval for protected professional activities.

intents.description: Visitor explores AI, blockchain, crypto or gaming category licensing; do not guarantee approvals.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Avoid equating software/blockchain support with regulated crypto trading or financial services. Escalate conditional approvals.

intents.description: Property consultancy, facilities management or leasing SUPPORT activity (not direct plot leasing).
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Distinguish property support from plot rental or licensed property brokerage; escalate direct brokerage legality.

intents.description: Visitor is considering a licence without visa allocations.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Explain zero-visa package without pitching a visa. Ask about business activity only if it changes guidance.

intents.description: Visitor asks about a business licence with residence visa allocations.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Answer any published package price upfront when enough details exist; ask one missing visa-count or term question, not contact.

intents.description: Visitor compares licence and office or visa package options.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Present concise evidence-based comparison first. If visitor wants a recommendation, ask a single relevant question, often visa count.

intents.description: Visitor asks for tailored licence or full setup fees.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Explicit tailored quote request: collect business activity, visa count and license term if missing; then ask contact with explicit consent.

intents.description: Visitor wants investor or shareholder residence visa support alongside business requirements.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Discuss general investor/shareholder visa guidance grounded in approved sources; do not guarantee approval or timings.

intents.description: Visitor wants employee visas or visa allocation for staffing.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Discuss staff visa allocation and quota; if visitor specifies headcount, remember it, do not request the same count again.

intents.description: Visitor needs guidance about dependents/family under a business setup; eligibility must be verified.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Dependent/family visa information is conditional and must not assume sponsor eligibility.

intents.description: Visitor needs a shared workspace or flexi-desk option.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Discuss flexi/shared desk and whether a physical workplace is needed; verify real availability.

intents.description: Visitor seeks an executive or private office package.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Distinguish business address and dedicated office needs; do not guarantee office inventory.

intents.description: Visitor asks about ANCFZ retail package or premises suitability; availability requires verification.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Check suitability of physical retail needs and area rather than equating a retail package with any shop location.

intents.description: Visitor wants assistance/introduction for a business account; bank approval is never guaranteed.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Explain banking support, never guarantee account opening; introductions are only with user consent.

intents.description: Visitor asks about package instalments or Tabby availability subject to eligibility.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Describe only approved installment methods with conditional eligibility. Do not claim payment approvals.

intents.description: Visitor explicitly requests sales contact or an advisor call.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; User explicitly wants a callback: prioritize preferred time/channel and consent, minimize other questions.

intents.description: Visitor requests to meet an ANCFZ advisor; no calendar booking without verified integration.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; User requests a meeting: ask preferred time and channel, explicitly state booking is only requested until confirmed.

intents.description: Visitor requests a tailored proposal or follow-up offer.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; User requests a tailored proposal: gather enough scope to hand over, avoid collecting every optional field.

intents.description: Visitor requests an introduction to a listed banking or entrepreneurship partner; route for staff confirmation.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Confirm which partner and purpose; partner outreach requires explicit authorization and staff verification.

intents.description: Existing ANCFZ licence holder asks to add visas, activities or office capacity.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Existing customer adding activities, visas or office resources: distinguish expansion opportunity from routine support.

intents.description: Existing customer asks about renewal: support case by default, not automatic new Salesforce Lead.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Service intent by default. Provide general renewal information first; request identifying data only for actual case creation. Informational questions are not service case requests.

intents.description: Existing customer requests a licence amendment: service case unless explicit new sales opportunity.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Support intent by default. Ask what change is needed, not a new-sales intake. Informational questions are not service case requests.

intents.description: Customer asks about portal access, applications or documents; no new Salesforce sales lead.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Help with known public portal information; no account verification or private status disclosed in public chat. Informational questions are not service case requests.

intents.description: Visitor requests regulatory, UBO, AML or tax guidance; human referral, not legal advice.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Explain only verified public compliance guidance, then offer an authorized specialist referral; not legal or tax advice.

intents.description: Visitor explicitly wants to submit a supporting business document for an existing enquiry. Attachment is a secondary action; preserve the active primary lead/support intent and do not initiate a new CRM lead from this intent alone.
intents.versionNote: ANCFZ human-conversation v2; route by explicit visitor intent; discover before contact; answer first; CRM only after explicit opt-in; Only if the visitor explicitly wants to attach a business document. Require upload consent and preserve primary intent.
